scope: Independent cross review of repaired9 findings; source and deployment unchanged, isolated probes only

findings.title: Old negative receipt clears successor unknown deletion
findings.trigger: A prepares DeletePod and returns not_sent but stalls before Finish; B takes lease and dispatches same Mutation with unknown result; Resume accepted; A late not_sent closes B journal; Resume sees still Ready original Pod and succeeds before B delayed deletion.
findings.impact: Outstanding old deletion is no longer fenced from completing new Resume; original Pod may stop after Resume succeeded. UID fence protects replacement UID, but does not preserve intent ordering.
findings.suggestion: Identify/fence each dispatch attempt; old negative receipts may not close uncertainty from a newer attempt. Preserve attributable refs separately from journal closure.
findings.verification: reproduced using actual repository and exclusive PostgreSQL17.11 with scheduled Provider boundary outcomes

findings.title: Wrong configured cluster can falsely prove original cleanup
findings.trigger: Keep DB but change Compute/Sandbox current ClusterID and kubeconfig together; old frozen record from clusterA is observed by clusterB client. ClusterB returns NotFound for names/UIDs, although original A objects remain.
findings.impact: ObservedDeleted/cleanup receipt can be emitted using wrong cluster absence; old Pod/PVC/PV leaked in A. Requires operator configuration change, not an ordinary tenant request.
findings.suggestion: Bind Provider to configured cluster identity and reject mismatched frozen snapshots before Observe/Apply; absence in another cluster cannot be evidence.
findings.verification: reproduced with two isolated Kubernetes dynamic fake clients; original UID objects remain in A while B emits cleanup receipt

findings.title: Lost workspace blocks accepted pause from stopping known owned Pod
findings.trigger: Original PVC becomes Lost while original owned Ready Pod remains; Pause accepted. Observe returns WORKSPACE_LOST; worker returns before DesiredPaused child deletion.
findings.impact: Pause does not stop runtime; repeated reconciliation sends zero mutations despite known Pod ownership/UID.
findings.suggestion: Permit safe UID-fenced Pod stop for paused intent independently of unhealthy workspace; retain original storage identity and diagnostics.
findings.verification: five real Worker+Provider cycles with fake Kubernetes boundary reproduce unchanged ReadyPod and zero mutations

findings.title: Accepted pause in WFFC provisioning window cannot converge
findings.trigger: Workspace created, WFFC PVC Pending, no consumer Pod yet; Pause accepted. Pause branch creates no Pod, but observed paused requires Bound, so claim can never bind.
findings.impact: Accepted pause remains provisioning/retrying indefinitely; no consumer can satisfy the guard.
findings.suggestion: Define paused from stopped runtime while preserving pending PVC, or explicitly reject unsupported action at acceptance; do not accept a state that cannot progress.
findings.verification: five Worker+Provider cycles reproduce Pending PVC/provisioning and zero mutations

findings.title: Resolution error misses concurrently accepted frozen replay
findings.trigger: A preflight Get NotFound; same-intent B persists acceptance; preset disabled/deleted/unavailable before A Resolve; A returns resolution error without rereading B. Next identical retry replays B immediately.
findings.impact: Same accepted public intent is still coupled to mutable catalog in preflight/resolution race. Existing AlreadyExists fallback is too late to cover this window.
findings.suggestion: On resolution failure, reread stable ID and replay matching persisted winner; retain original error if no winner, and preserve lookup infrastructure failures.
findings.verification: real Governance CreateSandbox via isolated Go overlay reproduced disabled-preset error followed by exact successful replay

knownConservativeLimitation.behavior: Crash after Prepare commit and before Apply dispatch leaves absent unknown create pending indefinitely; later Delete also remains unknown.
knownConservativeLimitation.assessment: Documented conservative policy disallows blindly retrying/canceling unknown creates; liveness limitation, not counted as a sixth defect. No manual recovery API implemented.

verificationNotes: Probe exit0 means residual was reproduced, not that implementation satisfies desired behavior.
